details.finite_fourier_dimensions: Functions of the first torus coordinate, embedded in every admitted d>=3; full pair gradients retain both slots.
details.limitations: Finite exact diagnostics support algebra only. They do not prove singular estimates, domain regularity, actual-law transfer, or an independent audit of this report.
details.method: Exact rational Laurent-polynomial arithmetic and exact rational radial/scaling checks.
details.nonproduct_density: 1 + (1/4) average_ordered_pairs cos(x_i-x_j) + (1/5) average_ordered_triples cos(x_i+x_j-2*x_k), with the triple term absent at N=2.
details.physical_convention: D_i=(2*pi*i)^(-1) partial_i. Every two-derivative expression restores (2*pi)^2 and the displayed i^2=-1. Brownian coefficient is sqrt(2*nu), sigma_N^2=N*min(beta_N,1), nu=1/beta_N for positive nu.
